scope.en: Dispatcher 1280, event 1285 and its random results 1290/1291/1292.

texts.zh:
在[From.Owner.Capital.GetName]上，居民们正在使用原始的雕刻图画来表达和分享想法。我们的研究人员记录的样本表明，居民对他们自己星球以外的天体有认识，甚至已经开始记录星座。

对于这样一个年轻的文明来说，他们早期绘制的星图是相当准确的，但也不至于到了无法改进的地步，只要我们想留下一些暗示……
texts.en:
On [From.Owner.Capital.GetName], the inhabitants are using crudely carved imagery to express and share ideas. Samples documented by our researchers indicate that the inhabitants have an awareness of celestial bodies beyond their own planet, and have even begun to document constellations.

Their early attempts at charting the stars are fairly accurate for such a young civilization, but not so much that they couldn't be improved should we wish to drop some hints...

label.zh: 继续被动观察。他们必须自食其力。
label.en: Continue passive observations. They must learn on their own.

label.zh: 也许我们可以默默地把他们推向正确的方向……
label.en: Perhaps we could subtly point them in the right direction...

title.en: Written in the Stars: Charts Delivered

texts.zh:
由[FromFrom.Owner.Capital.GetName]的居民绘制的早期星图被我们暗中修订了。

描绘附近恒星系图样的雕刻是在附近的一个山洞里制作的。一旦它们被发现，它们应该能够让当地居民对已知宇宙的规模有一个更好的认识。
texts.en:
The early star charts of the inhabitants on [FromFrom.Owner.Capital.GetName] have been covertly corrected.

Carvings depicting nearby system diagrams were made in a nearby cave. Once they are discovered, they should provide the local population with a better sense of the scale of the known universe.

title.en: Written in the Stars: Charts Received

texts.zh:
不幸的是，由于[FromFromFrom.Owner.Capital.GetName]的居民不知道是谁负责制作了他们的新星图，他们把我们的所作所为视作单纯的破坏行为。山洞周围的安保措施得到了加强，统治精英们对新形式的自我表达越来越敌视……

从积极的方面看，我们的干预并不是完全浪费时间。他们对这一事件的反应在文化研究方面很有价值。
texts.en:
Unfortunately, since the inhabitants of [FromFromFrom.Owner.Capital.GetName] did not know who was responsible for their new star charts, they passed off our efforts as simple vandalism. Security around the caves has increased, and the ruling elite has grown hostile to new forms of self-expression...

On a positive note, our interference was not a complete waste of time. their reaction to this event has proven fascinating in terms of cultural research.

texts.zh: 我们没能顺利地在暗中纠正[FromFrom.Owner.Capital.GetName]的星图。对于一个如此年幼的社会而言他们的安保措施令人意外地复杂。对目前的任务来说，暴露的风险太高了。至少目前当地居民需要依靠自己的力量来探索星空了。
texts.en: Our efforts to covertly correct the star charts on [FromFrom.Owner.Capital.GetName] have been unsuccessful. Their security protocols are surprisingly sophisticated for such a young society. Given our current mission, the risks of exposure were too high. For now at least, the inhabitants will have to face their astronomical aspirations alone.

# 写在星间！ / Written in the Stars!

- 分类 Category：文明纪事 Society (C7) · 审阅 Reviewed 2026-10-12
- 来源 Sources：`events/first_contact_dlc_events.txt:1781-2066`；common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:140-201（每月观测事件池）；`events/first_contact_dlc_situation_events.txt:316-376`（preftl.50）

## 如何开始 How it starts

- 被观测的前超光速文明的“科技进步”局势每月有 5/100 的机会运行 preftl.50（之后 1800 天冷却），从每月观测事件池中按权重抽取一个条件满足的事件；本事件权重 100。“挣脱桎梏”帝国观测原母族时使用的专用事件池中也有本事件。
  The observed pre-FTL civilization's tech-progress situation has a 5/100 monthly chance to run preftl.50 (then an 1800-day cooldown), which draws one valid event from the monthly observation pool by weight; this event has weight 100. It is also in the separate pool used when a Broken Shackles empire observes its parent civilization.
- 条件：青铜或铁器时代、被动观察（或游牧中继站观察者），被观测者不是格式塔；每个前超光速文明一次。
  Conditions: Bronze or Iron Age, Passive Observation (or nomad waystation), the observed civilization is not a gestalt; once per pre-FTL civilization.
- 隐藏分派事件设置一次性标记，然后在 0–25 天后向观测哨站拥有者（及游牧中继站观察者）发出可见事件。
  The hidden dispatcher sets a once-only flag and sends the visible event to the observation post owner (and nomad waystation observers) after 0-25 days.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

- 1285「写在星间！」：原始居民开始绘制星图。
  1285 "Written in the Stars!": the natives begin charting the stars.
- 继续被动观察，或“暗中指点”：70% 1290「图表已递交」→ 100 天后 1291「图表已收获」（被当作破坏行为，但带来文化研究）；30% 1292「拦截」（行动失败）。
  Keep observing, or "point them in the right direction": 70% 1290 "Charts Delivered" → 100 days later 1291 "Charts Received" (taken as vandalism, but yields cultural research); 30% 1292 "Intercepted" (the attempt fails).

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

- 1290 与 1292 为互斥随机结果（70/30）。
  1290 and 1292 are exclusive random results (70/30).
- 这是随机观测插曲：只在满足条件时可能出现，彼此之间没有固定顺序。
  This is a random observation interlude: it may appear only when its conditions hold, with no fixed order relative to other interludes.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

- 无额外的文明差异分支。
  No further empire-specific variants.

## 审阅记录 Review notes

- 已核对：触发、随机权重与 100 天延迟。
  Checked: trigger, random weights and the 100-day delay.
